articles.summary: A survey, commissioned by IBM and conducted by Morning Consult, finds that the systems supporting responsible AI use are still catching up, pointing to a gap between how quickly AI is entering classrooms and how prepared schools are to manage it.
articles.title: New IBM Study Finds AI Adoption Is Outpacing K-12 Readiness
